title: Data Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Data Coordinator

Location: Doncaster, South Yorkshire

Salary: £27000 to £30000 per annum

Job Type: Permanent, Full time

About the role:

As the Data Coordinator, you will support the accurate, timely and consistent flow of data across the organisation. The role is focused on monitoring data processes, maintaining datasets, coordinating reporting cycles, carrying out quality checks and ensuring that data is complete, reliable and ready for operational use. You will work closely with internal teams to resolve data issues, improve processes and maintain clear documentation, with limited direct client-facing responsibility.

Data Operations and Monitoring

  • Monitor scheduled data collection, scraping, processing and import activities, identifying failures, gaps or delays.
  • Coordinate the receipt, preparation and upload of daily, weekly and monthly data files.
  • Maintain core datasets, reference tables and supporting records in line with agreed processes.
  • Investigate data exceptions and work with relevant internal teams to resolve issues promptly.
  • Track recurring operational tasks and ensure deadlines, dependencies and hand-offs are managed effectively.

Data Reporting and Analysis Support

  • Prepare, process and distribute scheduled operational reports in accordance with agreed reporting calendars.
  • Sense-check weekly and monthly reports for completeness, consistency and accuracy before release.
  • Reconcile figures across source systems, spreadsheets and reporting outputs, escalating material discrepancies.
  • Maintain reporting trackers and provide clear status updates on report readiness, outstanding inputs and data issues.
  • Support ad-hoc data requests and analysis for internal stakeholders, ensuring outputs are appropriately checked and documented.

About you:

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Experience in a data administration, data operations, reporting or coordination role.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including the ability to organise, reconcile and validate structured data.
  • Working knowledge of databases and data extraction tools; experience with SQL or MySQL is advantageous.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to checking information.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage recurring tasks and competing deadlines, deal with ad-hoc requests, and adapt and re-prioritise accordingly.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills for working effectively with internal stakeholders.
  • Confidence investigating issues, following defined processes and escalating risks appropriately.
  • A responsible approach to confidential, commercially sensitive and personal data.
  • Desirable Experience
  • Experience using reporting or visualisation tools such as Power BI.
  • Familiarity with Jira or another ticketing or work-management platform.
  • Experience with data validation, data cleansing, master data or reference data.

Additional Information:

Please click on the APPLY button to send your CV and Cover Letter for this role.

Candidates with experience of: Data Administrator, Data Operations Analyst, Reporting Analyst, MI Analyst, Data Assistant, Database Administrator will also be considered for this role.
